name: Kunze Jiang
description: Kunze Jiang is a master's student at the University of Science and Technology of China, researching VLM post-training and reinforcement learning.
bio: I am currently pursuing an M.Eng. in Computer Technology at the University of Science and Technology of China (USTC, 2025–2028). I received my B.Eng. in Computer Science and Technology from Jiangxi Normal University (2021–2025).
My research interests include VLM post-training and reinforcement learning.
